Usage: yantra config [options] [command]

Inspect and update installation configuration

Options:
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  path [options]
  list [options]
  get [options] <key>
  set [options] <key> <value>
  unset [options] <key>
  edit [options]
  validate [options]
  data-dir [options] [path]
  help [command]               display help for command
